description: Query and parse a domain's CAA records: which certificate authorities are authorized to issue TLS certificates, whether wildcards are covered separately, and where violation reports go. A CAA policy locks the domain against mis-issuance by CAs the owner never chose. Use this when an agent needs to which certificate authorities may issue for this domain?. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
